fields.statement: At 3a81c930, built rhiza with go build and ran it by hand against this repo's real runs (6 live, several finished). rhiza tui app runs --once was byte-identical (cmp) to rhiza run ls --json, and rhiza tui app live now exits 4 with unknown app "live". Interactive in tmux (120x30): an InfoPanel titled Runs listed exactly the 6 live runs, one line each with change set title, current step (review/review, build/build, wait-pr) and elapsed time; finished runs were not listed. Five seconds later the elapsed times had advanced with no key pressed, so it refreshes on its own. Arrow keys scrolled; q closed with exit 0. From tui app health, enter on the daemon row opened the Runs panel. Minor: there the health report's top three lines stayed drawn above the panel, which the old live app did not do.
